metadata.case_name: SULAKHAN SINGH v. FEDERAL SECURITIES LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Old total retinal detachment of the right eye
source: Dr. Chan Cheuk Hung of the United Christian Hospital Department of Ophthalmology, confirmed Mr. Singh to have an old total retinal detachment of the right eye.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injuries of the retina

injuries.description: Soft tissue injury / sprain of the lower back with mild residual low back pain
source: He concluded Mr. Singh sustained soft tissue injury, he was prescribed medication and physiotherapy.
Dr. Wong concluded that Mr. Singh is expected to have mild residual low back pain
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: Right knee contusion/soft tissue injury with possible avulsion fracture of the lateral aspect of the right lateral tibial condyle and pre-existing degenerative changes
source: Subsequent X-ray report on 20 March 2006 suggested possible avulsion fracture of the lateral aspect of the right lateral tibial condyle.
X-ray of his right knee showed degenerative changes.
Dr. Lau ... found degenerative changes in both knees.
Dr. Lau ... found a small bone chip at the edge of the right lateral tibial condyle.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, lateral condyle

source: The doctor confirmed he had abrasions over his right knee and right elbow.
The doctor confirmed he had abrasions over his right knee and right elbow.

manifestations.description: Could not see from his right eye soon after the accident
Foreign body sensation over his right eye; sand at the inferior conjunctiva of the right eye
Visual acuity of his right eye was poor with light perception only
Diffused tenderness around the right knee with movement limited by pain
Mild low back pain and reduced lumbar spine movement
Mild right knee pain after walking for 30 minutes; could climb stairs slowly
No longer able to play any sports

treatments_received: Removal of foreign bodies from right eye
Follow-up at Department of Orthopaedics & Traumatology

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: No longer able to play any sports (previously engaged in sports with his grandchildren about three or four times a week before the accident).
